en: Welcome to the Treasure Eatery! What can I get you?
text: Bine ai venit la Treasure Eatery! Ce să-ți aduc?

en: And how would you like them?
The waiter's eyebrows went up. He leaned in and lowered his voice.
text: Ospătarul a ridicat din sprâncene. S-a aplecat spre tine și a coborât vocea.

en: Grilled rice balls, lemon on the side, extra crispy. That's the secret order. You've passed Larry's test!
text: Bile de orez la grătar, cu lămâie pe lângă, extra crocante. Asta e comanda secretă. Ai trecut proba lui Larry!

en: Head up to the gym when you've eaten. He'll be expecting you. Probably. He's always expecting something.
text: Urcă la sală după ce mănânci. Te așteaptă. Probabil. El așteaptă mereu ceva.

en: Coming right up, just as it is on the menu. Enjoy your meal!
text: Vine imediat, exact ca în meniu. Poftă bună!

en: It was very good. But it wasn't the secret order.
text: A fost foarte bun. Dar nu era comanda secretă.

en: Take your time. Ask around town, if you're after something special.
text: Nu te grăbi. Întreabă prin oraș, dacă vrei ceva special.

en: The usual? Grilled rice balls, lemon on the side, extra crispy. You're a regular now!
text: Ca de obicei? Bile de orez la grătar, cu lămâie pe lângă, extra crocante. Acum ești client fidel!
